summary: The round-8 front-offset guard judges only sketch ids the script's sketch() returned, and a panel/slider value written to an internal copy sketch (sk2_offset, a real slot from model-codegen generatedParams) escapes it: the offset is applied after the script and the part builds with no sentence. Repeat/mirror copy rows (left-right, top-bottom, repeat) and the authored-offset refusals replay exactly against closed forms, but this hole is the same refused class built silently.

defects.feature: row 2/3: repeat/mirror copy sketches vs guardFrontOffset ctx.authored
defects.problem: Student-typed front offset on a copy sketch is not judged. Repeat circle pocket (front 0, step [0,-10,0]) with RunOptions.values {sk2_offset:-12} builds: doc sk2 offset -12, vol 63717.304, no refusal; repeat along x (copy offset 0) with {sk2_offset:6} builds silently too (sk2 offset 6). The panel exposes offset slots for every sketch including copies, so a student can place a front offset the guard exists to refuse, uncaught (valuesVerdicts handles only across/r/g slots, not offset). Row 3 claims a slider moving a front sketch off 0 is refused, true only for sk1.

With no script probe ctx.authored is undefined and every front sketch is judged, so a saved document with repeat copies at nonzero offset is refused (over-refusal, safe); not exercised by any stored case.

Two circles tangent outside on one sketch build (2 bodies, vol 9423.714 vs closed form 9424.778, 1.1e-4) while row 66 lists touching-at-a-point shapes as refused; not checked which row covers this case.

notMeasured: mirror front-back was refused by the interpreter for pockets (so its y-mirror copy offsets were measured only with a circle at -8: closed form matches, 7.4e-7)
pad (extrude) repeat does not create copy sketches in this interpreter; not a copy-sketch path
real host adoption of ctx.authored (guard not adopted, row 68)
